Research position overview

This Canterbury project develops data-driven models of braided river morphodynamics. It connects observations and modelling to understand how braided river systems change, offering a funded doctoral route in river and environmental research.

Research Areas

  • River morphodynamics
  • Data-driven modelling
  • Environmental science

Funding and duration

ComponentDetails

Stipend / salaryNZD 32,650/year plus tuition
DurationThree years
Research expensesUp to NZD 5,000 over the degree, separate from the annual stipend
